title: A hot laptop throttles: master status and Workers show the reading, the halved trial cap and launches waiting
description: GY-3416: with a fixture hwmon reporting package 95C and core 96C against a 105C critical — a reading the guard once compared to its own crit-3 (102C) and never held — the limit is min(85C, crit-3): master status carries the hottest package or core sensor (96C), the trial cap halved from 4 to 2 and one launches-waiting line, and the Workers page shows the same three beside the sessions.
